title: kernel-writing-guide
summary: Decision guide for writing custom inference kernels: when to write one, which framework to choose (Triton, CuTe DSL, CUDA C++, AscendC/TileIR), universal correctness rules that apply regardless of framework, and the verify-before-benchmark workflow. Use before starting any kernel implementation to avoid common correctness and performance pitfalls.
